meta.descricao: The free people's school of the Instituto Lúcia, with no sign-up: a path, a class and a record of what you studied.

entrada.linhaNaoUniversidade: A free people's school, with no sign-up. It is not a university and does not award diplomas: it gives you a path, a class and a record of what you studied.

passos.texto: Say what you want and how much time you have. No name, email or ID: your enrolment stays on your device.
Pick a course built only from lessons that already exist at the Instituto.
If you like, study together with others taking the same course.
Take what you learned beyond the screen: at work, at home, in your neighbourhood.
At the end, a graduation and the record book of what you studied.
